about: PoE2 1.0 PREVIEW uniques (every line '1.0 preview, subject to change'). Read only with a request's preview_1_0 switch (builder/preview add_uniques). Lines are poe2db's reveal cards (read 23 Nov 2026), in PoB's raw item text. The reveal shows ONE roll of each line and no ranges: each line is that roll, fixed (MEDIUM; the real ranges are unpublished). 'changed': true = a 0.5.5 unique whose 1.0 text replaces its 0.5.5 text while the switch is on (its 0.5.5 market price kept). New uniques have no market: offered only without a divine cap or in SSF (preview.unique_price). Three bases PoB lacks are in 'bases', derived from their uniques' cards. Granted skills (Perfect Squall, Frostflame, Tasalio's Charge ...) are in no data yet: their lines grant nothing (an UNDERCOUNT, each row's not_modelled).

bases.name: Twilight Longsword
bases.basis: No base page (poe2db 404). From Oro's Sacrifice's card: 1.51 attacks a second with its 21% increased Attack Speed = 1.25 base (LOW, rounded); crit 5%; its physical is unused (the unique has No Physical Damage); range and sockets as Ultra Greatsword's (LOW)

bases.name: Vampiric Longsword
bases.basis: No base page (poe2db 404). From Agnar's card: 15-25 Physical, 1.25 attacks a second, crit 10.01% with its +5.01% = 5% base; range and sockets as Ultra Greatsword's (LOW)

bases.name: Searing Wand
bases.basis: No base page (poe2db 404). Ashcaller's card shows only Wand and its requirement; socket limit as Withered Wand's, without its granted skill (LOW)
